title: HomeFlood Tier Eligibility and Coverage Limits Schedule
content:
**HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies** are written in six tiers: HomeFlood Renters, HomeFlood Essential, HomeFlood Standard, HomeFlood Plus, HomeFlood Premier and HomeFlood Estate. Each tier admits a defined insured interest and occupancy and writes its limits inside the bands below.

## Entry to each tier

| Tier | Insured interest | Occupancy | Dwelling replacement cost value accepted |
|---|---|---|---|
| HomeFlood Renters | residential tenant | a dwelling or residential unit rented as the insured's residence | no dwelling coverage written |
| HomeFlood Essential | owner | one-to-four family dwelling | at least 50,000 USD |
| HomeFlood Standard | owner | one-to-four family dwelling | at least 75,000 USD |
| HomeFlood Plus | owner | one-to-four family dwelling | at least 150,000 USD |
| HomeFlood Premier | owner | one-to-four family dwelling | at least 400,000 USD |
| HomeFlood Estate | owner | one-to-four family dwelling | at least 1,250,000 USD |

## Limits schedule (USD)

| Tier | Dwelling coverage written | Lowest dwelling limit | Highest dwelling limit | Lowest personal property limit | Highest personal property limit | Lowest replacement cost value | Other structures (percent of dwelling limit, in addition) | Limit increment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Renters | no | 0 | 0 | 10,000 | 100,000 | 0 | 0 | 1,000 |
| Essential | yes | 50,000 | 250,000 | 0 | 100,000 | 50,000 | 0 | 1,000 |
| Standard | yes | 50,000 | 500,000 | 0 | 150,000 | 75,000 | 10 | 1,000 |
| Plus | yes | 100,000 | 1,000,000 | 0 | 250,000 | 150,000 | 10 | 1,000 |
| Premier | yes | 250,000 | 2,000,000 | 0 | 500,000 | 400,000 | 10 | 1,000 |
| Estate | yes | 1,000,000 | 4,000,000 | 0 | 1,000,000 | 1,250,000 | 10 | 1,000 |

Plain figures without separators, for reference: Renters 0 / 0 / 10000 / 100000; Essential 50000 / 250000 / 0 / 100000; Standard 50000 / 500000 / 0 / 150000; Plus 100000 / 1000000 / 0 / 250000; Premier 250000 / 2000000 / 0 / 500000; Estate 1000000 / 4000000 / 0 / 1000000; lowest replacement cost values 0, 50000, 75000, 150000, 400000 and 1250000; increment 1000 in every tier.

## Reading the schedule

- Where a tier writes no dwelling coverage (HomeFlood Renters), its dwelling limits and lowest replacement cost value read 0.
- Other-structures coverage is a percent of the dwelling limit and is provided in addition to the dwelling limit, never carved out of it; a tier showing 0 provides none.
- Every limit is a whole multiple of the tier's increment.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a HomeFlood Standard dwelling limit of 300,000 USD carries other-structures coverage of 10 percent of that limit, that is 30,000 USD, in addition to the 300,000 USD.
